claim: The SAA-C03 exam is 130 minutes long for its 65 questions.

evidence.quote: I reviewed the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam guide to learn about the exam outline. This exam is 130 minutes long covering 65 questions.

note: The certification page (www/certification/certified-solutions-architect-associate, fetched 2026-10-09) states the same value as the two-word line '130 minutes' under the heading 'Exam duration', next to 'Exam format: 65 questions'; M4 cannot accept a two-word line as a quote and M8 forbids a quote that runs across the heading, so the AWS Training and Certification blog sentence, which names the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate exam in the sentence before, is the quoted evidence. The certification page remains the authority and agrees. Repaired 2026-10-11 after an unsure entail vote.
